title: Host CPU busy
description: CPU >85% for 15m. Identify sustained consumers; CPU alone does not page.

title: Host OOM kill
description: OOM kills occurred; inspect memory consumers and affected services.

title: UPS approaching host shutdown
description: Hosts shut down at 80% charge. Check mains power and the cross-power UPS topology immediately.

title: DNS, API or database transport unavailable
description: DNS/API/transport probe failed. TCP success alone does not prove authenticated DB queries or NFS writes work.

title: Collection heartbeat stale
description: Collector self-scrape is stale or missing. A query returning old stored samples is not a recovery.

title: Home control plane quorum at risk
description: Home control plane quorum at risk

title: Required deployment has no ready replicas
expression: (((kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace=~"app-nextcloud|app-epgstation|app-tnlastation|app-loockit|app-coupon-manager|app-coredns|cloudflared"} or kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="monitoring",deployment=~"pdc-agent|vmagent-victoria-metrics-agent|nut-exporter|blackbox-exporter-prometheus-blackbox-exporter|kube-state-metrics"} or kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="tfc-agent",deployment="tfc-agent"} or kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="kube-system",deployment="coredns"}) == bool 0) and (kube_deployment_spec_replicas > 0)) or vector(0)
description: Required deployment has no ready replicas

title: Backup freshness mariadb-backup: warn
expression: (((time() - (kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time{namespace="infra-db",cronjob="mariadb-backup"} or on(namespace,cronjob) (kube_cronjob_created{namespace="infra-db",cronjob="mariadb-backup"}))) > bool 93600) and ((time() - (kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time{namespace="infra-db",cronjob="mariadb-backup"} or on(namespace,cronjob) (kube_cronjob_created{namespace="infra-db",cronjob="mariadb-backup"}))) <= 172800)) or vector(0)
description: Last successful mariadb-backup is overdue. Check job logs and destination verification; job success does not prove an actual restore works.

title: Backup freshness mariadb-backup: critical
description: Last successful mariadb-backup is overdue. Check job logs and destination verification; job success does not prove an actual restore works.

description: Last successful nas-backup is overdue. Check job logs and destination verification; job success does not prove an actual restore works.

description: Last successful nas-backup is overdue. Check job logs and destination verification; job success does not prove an actual restore works.

description: Last successful victoria-metrics-backup is overdue. Check job logs and destination verification; job success does not prove an actual restore works.

title: NAS dataset capacity warn
description: SNMP mounted dataset use. Pool physical allocation and health require the TrueNAS API; snapshot pressure may not be visible here.

title: NAS dataset capacity critical
description: SNMP mounted dataset use. Pool physical allocation and health require the TrueNAS API; snapshot pressure may not be visible here.

title: Host systemd service failed
description: Explicitly monitored host services failed. Boot-only and unrelated units are not paged.

title: Required PVE guest stopped
expression: max by(id,name,node) ((pve_up{job="pve",id=~"qemu/(13001|13002|13003|13004|13005|69001|69002|14001)|lxc/12901"} == bool 0) * on(id,instance) group_left(name,node) pve_guest_info{job="pve",template="0"}) or vector(0)

title: Scheduled job has failed executions
description: Inspect the job and CronJob history. A prior failed attempt does not mean the latest backup is overdue; freshness is checked separately.

title: Management or optional deployment stopped
expression: (((kube_deployment_status_replicas_available == bool 0) and (kube_deployment_spec_replicas > 0)) unless (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace=~"app-nextcloud|app-epgstation|app-tnlastation|app-loockit|app-coupon-manager|app-coredns|cloudflared"} or kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="monitoring",deployment=~"pdc-agent|vmagent-victoria-metrics-agent|nut-exporter|blackbox-exporter-prometheus-blackbox-exporter|kube-state-metrics"} or kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="tfc-agent",deployment="tfc-agent"} or kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="kube-system",deployment="coredns"})) or vector(0)
description: A noncritical controller with desired replicas is unavailable. Zero desired replicas is normal.

title: Noncritical StatefulSet stopped
description: A noncritical controller with desired replicas is unavailable. Zero desired replicas is normal.

title: Host NIC receive errors
expression: (((rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{job=~"node_vm|node_kubernetes",device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|docker.*|br-.*|virbr.*|tap.*|fw.*|kube.*|dummy.*|sit.*|ip6tnl.*|tunl.*|teql.*"}[5m]) / clamp_min(rate(node_network_receive_packets_total{job=~"node_vm|node_kubernetes",device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|docker.*|br-.*|virbr.*|tap.*|fw.*|kube.*|dummy.*|sit.*|ip6tnl.*|tunl.*|teql.*"}[5m]), 1)) > bool 0.01) and (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{job=~"node_vm|node_kubernetes",device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|docker.*|br-.*|virbr.*|tap.*|fw.*|kube.*|dummy.*|sit.*|ip6tnl.*|tunl.*|teql.*"}[5m]) > 1) and on(job,instance,device) (node_network_info{job=~"node_vm|node_kubernetes",operstate="up"} == 1)) or vector(0)
description: Per active interface: 5-minute error rate >1% and >1 error/second for 5m. Excludes loopback and transient container interfaces. Inspect link, NIC and switch counters.

title: Host NIC transmit errors
expression: (((rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{job=~"node_vm|node_kubernetes",device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|docker.*|br-.*|virbr.*|tap.*|fw.*|kube.*|dummy.*|sit.*|ip6tnl.*|tunl.*|teql.*"}[5m]) / clamp_min(rate(node_network_transmit_packets_total{job=~"node_vm|node_kubernetes",device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|docker.*|br-.*|virbr.*|tap.*|fw.*|kube.*|dummy.*|sit.*|ip6tnl.*|tunl.*|teql.*"}[5m]), 1)) > bool 0.01) and (rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{job=~"node_vm|node_kubernetes",device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|docker.*|br-.*|virbr.*|tap.*|fw.*|kube.*|dummy.*|sit.*|ip6tnl.*|tunl.*|teql.*"}[5m]) > 1) and on(job,instance,device) (node_network_info{job=~"node_vm|node_kubernetes",operstate="up"} == 1)) or vector(0)
description: Per active interface: 5-minute error rate >1% and >1 error/second for 5m. Excludes loopback and transient container interfaces. Inspect link, NIC and switch counters.

title: IX2215 receive errors
description: Per active LAN/WAN/VLAN interface: >1 events/second for 5m. Check physical errors, congestion and interface counters; unused interfaces are excluded.

title: IX2215 transmit errors
description: Per active LAN/WAN/VLAN interface: >1 events/second for 5m. Check physical errors, congestion and interface counters; unused interfaces are excluded.

title: IX2215 receive drops
description: Per active LAN/WAN/VLAN interface: >10 events/second for 5m. Check physical errors, congestion and interface counters; unused interfaces are excluded.

title: IX2215 transmit drops
description: Per active LAN/WAN/VLAN interface: >10 events/second for 5m. Check physical errors, congestion and interface counters; unused interfaces are excluded.

title: Host load average high
expression: (node_load5{job=~"node_vm|node_kubernetes"} / on(job,instance) group_left count by(job,instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"node_vm|node_kubernetes",mode="idle"}) > bool 1.5) or vector(0)
description: Five-minute load average per CPU core >1.5 for 15m. Check runnable tasks and uninterruptible I/O waits alongside CPU and storage metrics.

title: Internet download speed low
description: At least 3 measurements in 15m are all below 25 Mbps, with the latest sample less than 10m old. Check concurrent transfers and test server before diagnosing the WAN.

title: Internet upload speed low
description: At least 3 measurements in 15m are all below 20 Mbps, with the latest sample less than 10m old. Check concurrent transfers and test server before diagnosing the WAN.

title: Public service unavailable through Cloudflare Access
description: Authenticated public URL must return HTTP 200 and the expected service body. Redirects, Access login pages, DNS/TLS/auth failures are not success. Service-token probes do not exercise interactive IdP login.

title: Public TLS certificate expires soon
expression: ((home_access_tls_expiry_seconds{job="home-service-monitor"} - time() < bool 1209600) and (home_access_tls_expiry_seconds{job="home-service-monitor"} - time() >= 259200)) or vector(0)

title: Database queries running longer than 60 seconds
description: Database queries running longer than 60 seconds

title: Recording stopped before its scheduled end
description: Recording stopped before its scheduled end

title: Completed recording has no video file
description: Completed recording has no video file

title: Recording conflict in the next 24 hours
description: Recording conflict in the next 24 hours

description: Per-TV-service epgUpdatedAt from Mirakurun; another channel updating cannot hide a stale channel.

title: Television EPG not updated in 48 hours
description: Per-TV-service EPG update stopped for more than 48 hours.

description: Oldest recording waiting for encoding warn

description: PBS has no verified snapshot in 7 days

title: Recorded media destination check stale

description: NAS restic repository storage budget warn

title: Fewer than two etcd members report a leader
expression: ((sum((etcd_server_has_leader{job="etcd"} == 1) and on(instance) (up{job="etcd"} == 1)) or vector(0)) < bool 2) or vector(0)
description: Fewer than two etcd members report a leader

title: Etcd leader count is not one
expression: ((sum(etcd_server_is_leader{job="etcd"} and on(instance) (up{job="etcd"} == 1)) or vector(0)) != bool 1) or vector(0)
description: Etcd leader count is not one

title: API VIP must be owned by exactly one control-plane node
description: API VIP must be owned by exactly one control-plane node

title: Home runner jobs remain queued
expression: ((sum by(scale_set) (gha_assigned_jobs{job="arc-home"}) - sum by(scale_set) (gha_busy_runners{job="arc-home"})) > bool 0) or vector(0)

title: Kubernetes API certificate expiry warn
expression: ((probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job="blackbox_api"} - time() < bool 1209600) and (probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job="blackbox_api"} - time() >= 259200)) or vector(0)

title: Backup repository inventory unavailable
description: S3 repository object inventory could not be read. Missing or empty repositories are failures.

title: Backup repository inventory stale
description: S3 inventory is collected hourly; last completed attempt is over three hours old.

title: Backup restore validation Job failed
description: Restore test failed. Inspect the isolated test Job; successful backup completion is not evidence of recoverability.

title: Recording preparation or capture failed
description: An actual recording failure hook ran within the last hour. EPGStation emits this event; API polling also checks currently overdue or prematurely stopped recordings.

title: Wi-Fi AP or managed switch unreachable
description: FS AP 192.168.0.253 and US-8-60W 192.168.0.252 must respond. Port-state alerts apply only to explicitly required ports in the inventory.

title: nas restore validation overdue
description: No successful restore validation in 28 days. NAS and DB isolated tests run weekly. PBS VM recovery is performed separately and its actual result is reported explicitly; backup or verify success does not substitute.

title: database restore validation overdue
description: No successful restore validation in 28 days. NAS and DB isolated tests run weekly. PBS VM recovery is performed separately and its actual result is reported explicitly; backup or verify success does not substitute.

title: Required switch port inventory is empty
